patch.value: Session role and topic provenance: the dimension agents need to attribute work is declared, mapped for one harness, and has never been recorded once

The role dimension is declared in AGENT_PROVENANCE_DIMENSIONS alongside model and effort, and exactly one built-in harness descriptor maps a source for it: codex, via CODEX_SESSION_ROLE. claude-code, pi, opencode, cursor, aider and gemini-cli declare no role source at all. Across all 44,408 history entries in this tracker, measured 2026-07-31, no entry has ever carried a role key - including the 3,223 codex-attributed entries whose harness does declare the mapping.

The capability this is missing matters more than a coverage number. Author identity today answers who wrote an entry at the granularity of harness plus opaque instance hash: harness:claude-code, agent_instance 4cc69f82c87e6e8164c8f176. It cannot answer what that session was for. A maintainer reading 4,772 claude-code entries cannot separate a planning session from a remediation session from a release cut, and the immutable record is the only place that distinction could ever have been made, because it cannot be reconstructed afterwards from item state.

Multi-agent operation is where the absence bites hardest. When thousands of agents work the same tracker across branches, the useful grouping is almost never by harness - they are all the same harness - and almost never by instance, which is too fine to aggregate and opaque to read. It is by role: which fleet, which task class, which sweep. Every fleet-level primitive in the roadmap needs it. Fleet-amortized context assembly in pm-tch9cs shares assemblies across agents doing the same kind of work and has no field that says what kind. Trajectory projection in pm-qd6gvf reads the record as observation-action-outcome episodes and cannot label an episode. The episode substrate in pm-li2fj5 needs a stable episode identity that survives across the several processes one episode spans.

Scope is a role and topic channel that does not require the harness to cooperate, because the evidence says harnesses will not: effort is exported by exactly one harness, model by none, and role by none. The design therefore has to admit a first-party channel - a workspace or invocation-scoped declaration that pm itself resolves - while keeping the existing environment and MCP client channels as higher-precedence sources when a harness does supply them. It must stay privacy-bounded like the other dimensions, since a free-text topic is the first provenance field that could carry sensitive content into an append-only record that pm-w7ccmv promises is unalterable.

Prerequisite ordering: explicit-unavailable must be generalized beyond model first (pm-9wbiye) or role will record the same unrecoverable absence that effort now records, and the coverage report must exist (pm-1wiugq) or a newly populated dimension will be as unobservable as the current ones.

A session role and a session topic are recordable through a first-party channel that works when no harness exports anything, and are written into agent_provenance alongside model and effort; Harness-supplied and MCP-client-supplied values take precedence over the first-party declaration, with the source recorded per observation exactly as model and effort already record it; The dimension records explicit unavailability when declared and unobserved, so it does not repeat the effort omission; History queries and the activity surface can filter and group by role, so 'what did the release-cut sessions change this week' is answerable from the record alone; Values are bounded in length and validated, and the documented guidance states that topic text enters an append-only stream that redaction can only mark, not remove; Coverage for the new dimension appears in the provenance coverage report with a negative control proving the report can distinguish observed from unavailable
The immutable record can say what a session was for, so 44,408 entries are groupable by role rather than only by harness and opaque instance.
role is declared, mapped by one of seven built-in harnesses, and has never been written in any entry; no first-party channel exists to supply it.
